# gpupaas_security_group (Data Source)

Look up a security group by name within a project, optionally scoped to a workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpupaas_security_group" "web" {
  project   = "system-catalog"
  workspace = "team-a"
  name      = "web"
}

output "rule_count" {
  value = length(data.gpupaas_security_group.web.spec.rules)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `project` (String)

### Optional
